messages:
Samira: Heads-up — I'm about to push a hotfix to the token-cache service in eu-west1. It's a tiny TLS handshake regression fix; image is pinned to `token-cache:v2.3.1-rc5`. Need expedited approval for a late-window patch (we're inside the 2hr change window). @Jon @Lee @ops_oncall please ack or raise concerns.
Jon: Can you paste the brief risk/rollback plan? Need to know impact surface.
Samira: TL;DR: affects short-lived TLS session handling; failure mode is connection retries -> higher tail latency (~2-3% p50->p95 shift in worst-case). Canary in staging passed. Rollback is trivial (pin back to `v2.3.0`) and traffic-shiftable. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/token-cache-hotfix (short checklist).
Samira: Quick commands we will use if we need to rollback:
```
kubectl set image deploy/token-cache token-cache=token-cache:v2.3.0 --namespace=prod-eu
deploybot rollback --service token-cache --to-tag v2.3.0 --reason "post-hotfix-issue"
```
Lee: I ran the perf diff locally and the change looks fine. My main ask: monitor TLS error-rate and connection-reuse metrics for 20m. If error-rate > 0.5% fire rollback. :thumbsup:
ops_oncall: I'm on call window. I'll watch the alerting for the next 30m and keep an eye on the circuit-breaker page. If we see a spike in `tls_handshake_failures` or `conn_reset_by_peer` -> I'll trigger traffic-shift to stable.
deploybot: [deploybot] Canaries initiated for token-cache:v2.3.1-rc5 in prod-eu (10% traffic). Canary checks: health, latency, tls_metrics. Initial canary started at 1761122360.
Samira: Starting staged rollout now, will post status updates. Adding PM note: @pm_ana pls update release notes and customer-comm if we need to extend window.
pm_ana: Noted — I'll be on standby to draft a short status update if we need an extended maintenance note.
deploybot: [deploybot] Canary progress: 10% -> 30% at 1761122385. All checks green so far (health=ok, tls_handshake_failures=0.02%, p95 latency delta +1%).
Jon: Looks good from my side. Approve to continue to 100% if no regressions in next 10m.
Lee: Approve.
ops_oncall: Approve with caveat — if we hit the rollback trigger I'll handle the shift and notify infra.
Samira: Thanks all. Proceeding to 100% now. Final image tag: token-cache:v2.3.1-rc5. Will keep this thread updated every 5m.
deploybot: [deploybot] Rollout to 100% completed at 1761122398. Post-rollout self-checks passing.
Samira: Post-deploy monitoring: tls_handshake_failures steady at 0.03%, error-rate within expected. Keeping window open for 30m extra as precaution.
ops_oncall: I'll leave enhanced monitoring on for the remainder of the change window and log incident if anything deviates.
pm_ana: Updating release notes now: "Hotfix: TLS session handling fix (token-cache) — rolled to prod-eu. No customer-facing behavior expected; monitoring in place."
Samira: Marking this hotfix as deployed. Will follow up with a short postmortem only if we see any anomalies. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
